method: QUOTED UNDER A 200-WORD BUDGET (199 words used), from Cancer Council Australia 'Clinical practice guidelines for the diagnosis and management of melanoma' v1.1 (published 2024-04-05), retrieved 2026-09-23 as MAGICapp JSON. Every pass claim is machine re-checkable. LICENCE: Free to read, NOT openly licensed. Cancer Council Australia's guideline FAQ: fair dealing needs only correct citation; reproducing 'more than 200 words or figures/tables' needs permission from guidelines@cancer.org.au. So quotes here are capped at 200 words per source guideline (enforced by the generator) and tables were stripped from the retrieved text before quoting, so none can be quoted.

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Suspect melanoma in any lesion that is Elevated, Firm and Growing for more than one month.**
claims.source_text: Any lesion that is Elevated, Firm and Growing over a period of more than one month should raise suspicion for melanoma.
claims.locator: Cancer Council Australia, 'Clinical practice guidelines for the diagnosis and management of melanoma', v1.1, published 2024-04-05, MAGICapp https://app.magicapp.org/#/guideline/Lkk3pL, retrieved 2026-09-23
